name: AgentStatusPanel - OverMcpServer
description: An agent working this map over HTTP rather than through the browser. This whole state was invisible before presence stopped meaning 'a WebMCP binding exists in this tab' — the page said nobody was attached while an agent wrote nodes onto the board. The copy draws the one distinction that matters to a person: it can read and write the map, but it cannot raise a question here, so anything they add waits in the log for its next read.
